title: Goldreich–Levin query run through a stage
statement: For a dimension $n$ and threshold $\tau\in(0,1]$, the query program run through stage $k$ is defined for each $k\le n$. At stage zero it returns the state with active family $\{\varnothing\}$ and empty trace; at each subsequent stage it leaves a state with no active family unchanged, performs the stage step when the active family has size at most the active cap, and otherwise returns a state with no active family and the same trace.
